FAIL_TO_PASS: return-function-deoptimization: does not deoptimize call arguments of returned functions by default
class-method-access: tracks side-effects when accessing class methods
nested-this-expressions: properly keep or ignore nested "this"-expressions
arrow-function-return-values: forwards return values of arrow functions
side-effects-call-arguments: side-effects in call arguments should be included
literal: Tree-shake known literal prototype functions
early-access-getter-return: handles accessing the return expression of a getter before it has been bound
side-effects-in-template-literals: detects side-effects in template literals and tagged template expressions
array-expression: Tree-shake known array prototype functions
destructured-known-arguments: tracks known argument values through destructuring
side-effect-free-array-expression: Tree-shakes side-effect-free array functions if only their return value is unused
static-class-property-calls: handles effects when calling static class properties
async-function-effects: tracks effects when awaiting thenables
recursive-calls: do not fail for recursive calls
conditional-expression: only retain branches with side-effects
keep-property-access-side-effects: keep side-effects when accessing properties if treeshake.propertyReadSideEffects is true
super-class-prototype-calls: correctly resolves the prototype of the super class when calling properties
side-effects-getters-and-setters: treat getters and setters as function calls
side-effects-this: When a constructor is called with the new keyword, changing its this has no side effects
side-effects-generators: Properly detect side-effects in generator functions
